Vegan, bar two dishes

The whole menu is vegan except the goat cheese salad and the goat cheese waffle.

Gluten free options

Marked GF-a on the menu. Ask the server about any allergy or intolerance.

No refined sugar

Desserts use maple syrup, coconut blossom sugar, xylitol, dates and fruit.

Options for diabetics

Including a keto and diabetic friendly cake, and a keto bowl at lunch.

Where the idea comes from.

Definitely from love to good food. I always dreamt about a small café, a place that I would confidently bring anyone and myself.

BioCafe is a passion for a healthy lifestyle: great fresh free-from food and truly nutritional snacks and bites. Call it fit, comfort food, a healthy diet or clean eating, they have it all. You do not need to be a vegetarian, vegan, raw or gluten free to fall in love with it.

They love to travel, and the kitchen shows it, with Indian, Greek, Italian and Turkish influences.

Bring your own bottle if you wish. Alcohol with lunch or dinner has a one-off corkage fee of £3.00 per person.
